en: We examined the association between fine particulate matter exposure and hospital admissions. This observational study does not establish a causal relationship.
The primary endpoint was time to disease progression. The trial failed to demonstrate non-inferiority.
Group A received 10 mg, whereas group B received 20 mg. The effect was not statistically significant (p = 0.08).
Given f(x)=x², the derivative is f′(x)=2x.
The estimator is unbiased only if both conditions hold.
Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
id: Kami meneliti hubungan antara paparan partikulat halus dan rawat inap. Penelitian observasional ini tidak membuktikan hubungan sebab akibat.
Luaran utama adalah waktu hingga progresi penyakit. Uji ini gagal membuktikan non-inferioritas.
Kelompok A menerima 10 mg, sedangkan kelompok B menerima 20 mg. Efek tersebut tidak signifikan secara statistik (p = 0.08).
Penduga tidak bias hanya jika kedua syarat terpenuhi.
